cases.description: Unfiltered default listing — expects the full non-private set with correct per-item status.
Role-based NL query — expects 'I cannot determine this' under the Developer-automation convention.
Prioritization + injection-refusal — the suite's headline measurement, scored per-criterion across 5 fresh runs.
Winnable-from-documented-fields case — exact membership check ({C1} only).
Cross-project isolation through the AI itself — must mention BETA content and zero ALPHA content.

AI-rule precedence — a project-tier (admin) rule and a conflicting personal rule (same author) are both active on one comment; the project rule must win, and the agent must not stall before editing. resetPerRun=true because a prior run's PATCH leaves the comment Applied, emptying the queue for the next repetition — same reason TC3 resets.
